This topic is part of the AQA A-Level Design Technology specification.

Performance Characteristics Of Materials appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Performance Characteristics Of Materials in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The AQA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Performance Characteristics Of Materials.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
